correctness.rationale: Direct exact full-face algorithm, verified 168 Fano collineations and 336 graph automorphisms, exhaustive 3462 matching masks and all 30 disjoint matching orbits, and all 121 representative deletions reduce 28910 relative elementary face pairs with empty residuals. Each free pair is a true codimension-one simplicial collapse. A complete 8850-node Hasse topological-sort verifies a one-vertex one-six-cell acyclic Morse model for the intact complex. Therefore all nested matching inclusions preserve the integral S6 homotopy type and homology classes.

value.rationale: A canonical cubic nonchordal graph retains its entire integral simple-homotopy and inclusion-map topology under every matching-fault pattern of up to 7 of 21 edges, including 1260 nonextendible matchings. This precise robustness of a natural simplicial graph invariant is stronger than a stagewise Betti table and is not true for arbitrary graph edge deletions (seven-cycle boundary example).
